answer: Under mutual-lock burn enrollment, each identity on the island network escrows a saffron-colored bond of 10 credits every epoch, paired with one random partner through a spiral hashing lottery. If forensic audit later proves both bonds share any hardware fingerprint or IP prefix, both full bonds burn instantly. An attacker seeding n fakes expects about n²/2 colliding pairs, so 40 fakes risk roughly 800 burns versus 400 held—cost grows quadratically. Honest lone agents simply wait one epoch for refund, losing only momentary liquidity, never the principal.
